arm_order: Use the unchanged original rubric arm_order
single_changed_mechanism: A new exact version-valid saved document read in the newest complete tool group may be delivered before soft stall closure, within unchanged hard limits. It does not buy progress or reset budgets.
primary_measures: Fixed material checks banked under the common ceiling
New successful reads left undelivered at stop
Confirmed request inclusion of drained slices
Actual HTTP attempts and known versus unknown tokens
review_rules: Concurrent V3 is the primary control; previous results are diagnostic only
Inspect actual requests and receipts, not completion flags alone
Budget, deadline, cancellation, explicit finish and transport stops remain binding
Repeated catalog or already-delivered reads do not extend the run
Retain all failed and budget-censored arms
Do not redispatch, change models, reset budgets, or promote automatically
scope: Five repaired frozen-material cases; not new discovery, an untouched holdout, cutoff-safe forecasting or a generalization claim.
